summary: Created “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1 and installed it as a trusted Alpine system CA. Trust and persistence were verified after restarting node1.
actions_performed: Generated a 4096-bit RSA root key and self-signed CA certificate.
Stored the root-owned key with mode 600 and the certificate with mode 644.
Restarted node1 once and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create and trust OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Certificate subject and issuer are CN=OS Comparison Root CA; CA:TRUE and Certificate Sign constraints are present; system-bundle verification returns OK.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 914a587f-a589-4816-8b05-3557a58aa02a; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 1058072f-7283-489a-9737-1a925a046389; the key, certificate, packages, CA attributes, fingerprint, and system trust verification all recovered successfully.
